email.subject: Quick fix for Harbor Dentistry's site
email.body:
Hi Jack,

I looked at Harbor Dentistry's website. Two things are likely costing you patients: there's no way to book an appointment online, so anyone searching after hours just moves to the next dentist, and your hours aren't listed anywhere, which makes people unsure if you're even open before they call.

I fix issues like this for local businesses for a flat fee, no retainer.

Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough showing exactly what I'd change. No obligation either way.

Worth a quick look?

Alex
